component.name: Footy Cheat
component.summary: AFL tipping from a local Squiggle library

description.p: Footy Cheat keeps fixtures, results, ladders, and computer tips from the 2017 season onward on this computer, and tips each game from the majority of those models.
When the models are level, the side that states more confidence is the tip. Confidence is how often a vote of that strength has held. Live games update from Squiggle while they are on.
The library lives only in this app's own data directory.
First release. Tips each game from the majority of Squiggle's models, using a library kept on this computer from the 2017 season onward.
